jobDescription: Over three years the bank is refitting its two hundred branches to the new format, twelve branches at a time, without closing any branch for more than a fortnight. The Project Manager takes a cohort of branches from survey to reopening: agrees the refit schedule with the property team and the fit-out contractor, tracks each branch's cost against the cohort budget, reports fortnightly to the refit steering group, resolves the clashes between the fit-out and the branch's IT and cash-handling changes, and closes each branch with the snagging list and the reopening certificate. Reopening decisions are the regional director's. Reports to the refit programme lead; works with the property team, the contractor, branch operations and the regional directors.
requirements: Takes cohorts of branches from survey to reopening on an agreed refit schedule.
Tracks each branch's cost against the cohort budget and reports to the refit steering group.
Resolves clashes between the fit-out and the branches' IT and cash-handling changes through the programme's clash log.
Prepares reopening readiness for each branch, with the reopening decision staying with the regional director, and records own responsibility boundaries.
Closes each branch refit with the snagging list and the reopening certificate.

evidence.text: Refit project manager at a high-street bank from 2022 to 2025, taking four cohorts of twelve branches each from survey to reopening on schedules agreed with the property team and the fit-out contractor.
Tracked every branch's cost against the cohort budget in the programme cost tool and reported fortnightly to the refit steering group; the forty-eight branches closed within budget at cohort level.
Resolved the clashes between the fit-out and the branches' IT and cash-handling changes through the programme's clash log, with the IT and cash-handling teams' sign-off recorded against each clash.

Prepared the reopening readiness pack for each branch; the reopening decision was the regional director's, recorded on the pack together with the checks that were mine and the checks that were branch operations'.
Closed each branch refit with the snagging list agreed with the contractor and the reopening certificate countersigned by the branch manager.

Work sample: one cohort schedule, the cost tool extract for one cohort, one reopening readiness pack with the regional director's decision, and one snagging list with its reopening certificate, with the programme cost tool references as a verification trail.
Reference call with the refit programme lead: confirmed the four cohorts, the fortnightly steering reporting and that reopening decisions sat with the regional directors; confirmed the dates.
Steering group secretary's note: the panel would like the evidence set out per requirement with the cost tool references, and any verification points in a separate list for the debrief.
